title: UAAP: UST avoids collapse, puts Alas-less Ateneo out of Final 4 contention
summary: University of Santo Tomas staved off a 15-point collapse to eliminate Ateneo de Manila University, 89-84, in UAAP Season 89 men's basketball on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
